schema.file: The picture's path under this folder, such as dentists/1.jpg. A JPEG or a PNG, at least 1200 x 627 pixels (16:9 is best), at most 5 MB.
schema.category: The trade it suits: one of home_services, attorneys, finance_insurance, real_estate, dentists, physicians, health_fitness, automotive_repair, animals_pets, personal_services, fallback.
schema.services: The services it suits, such as Invisalign, matched without regard to capitals. Empty means a general picture of the trade. The first picture listed for a trade is the one used when no service matches.
schema.licence: Who licensed it to Admiry, and on what terms.
schema.source: Where it came from: an address or a licence number.
schema.alt: What the picture shows, in one plain sentence. The assistant reads it to owners who cannot see the picture, so say only what is there.
